title: Frosted dead moor grass
subject: Subject: the ground of a cold northern moor, about 3 m across, seen from above. Dead winter grass in pale straw and grey-brown, lying in soft swirls, dark moss between, and white frost rimed over all of it, heavier in some small patches, spread evenly. Cold silver-lavender colours, but the texture itself evenly lit.
use: The ground of the northern crossroads fight.

title: Old crossroads paving
subject: Subject: an old road of worn square and oblong grey paving stones, about 2.5 m across, seen from above. Stones of slightly different sizes laid in rough rows, some cracked or sunk, dead straw-coloured grass and frost in the joints and a few stones missing with earth showing. Spread evenly.
use: The paved roads and the ring at the northern crossroads.

title: Old standing stone
subject: Subject: one old standing stone, seen flat from the front, about 2.5 m high: a rough tall pillar of dark grey stone, slightly leaning, its top broken and uneven, grey-green lichen and white frost on its face, a little dead grass at its foot.
use: The standing stones round the ring at the northern crossroads.

title: Crossroads well with lantern post
subject: Subject: an old round well, seen flat from the front: a low wall of rough fitted grey stones about 1.5 m across, frost on its rim, and beside it a wooden gallows post about 3 m high with a short arm from which an iron lantern hangs, glowing warm.
use: The well at the northern crossroads (where the letter is left).

title: Bare frosted bush
subject: Subject: one leafless winter bush, about 2 m across and 1.8 m high: many thin dark twigs spreading up and out from a few stems, white frost along the twigs, dead grass at the foot. Cold silver night colours.
use: Round the edges of the northern crossroads fight.

title: Grey rock cliff face
subject: Subject: the face of a grey rock cliff, seen flat, about 6 m across: blocky fractured grey-violet rock in tall rough columns and shelves, dark cracks between, a little moss and frost on the ledges. An even spread, no single big feature.
use: Bare grey cliffs and rock outcrops seen side-on (the crossroads' sea cliffs); where snow lies thick, use shared_rock_cliff_snowy.
